activities.topic: Introduction to Augmented Reality and Real-World Integration

activity_1.title: Choose a Real Object
steps: Look around your house and select one object.
Notice its shape, size, and purpose.

activity_2.title: Imagine a Digital Object on It
steps: Imagine a digital object appearing on the real object.
Think creatively about what could appear.
Write one or two sentences describing your imagination.
examples: A small dinosaur walking on your table
A butterfly sitting on your notebook
Planets rotating above your school bag
A small robot standing on your bottle
Example: A small dinosaur is walking on my study table.

activity_3.title: Draw Your AR Scene
steps: Draw the real object in your notebook.
Combine both to create a complete scene.
Understand this as a mix of real and digital elements.

extra_exploration.task: Find places where AR could help in learning.

think_and_notice: Which real object did you choose?
What digital object did you imagine on it?
How could AR make school lessons more exciting?
activities.discussion_instruction: Discuss your ideas with your parents or elders.

learning_outcomes.title: Understand the concept of Augmented Reality
learning_outcomes.description: Students recognize how digital objects can appear on real-world surfaces.

learning_outcomes.title: Develop imagination and creative thinking
learning_outcomes.description: Students imagine how technology can enhance real-world environments.

learning_outcomes.title: Improve observation skills
learning_outcomes.description: Students analyze real objects and visualize digital additions.

learning_outcomes.title: Connect AR technology with education and daily life
learning_outcomes.description: Students understand how AR can improve learning and visualization.

bonus_activity: Look at a picture in a book or magazine.
Imagine the picture becoming alive in 3D.
Examples: animal moving, volcano erupting, car engine rotating
Think about how AR could bring images to life.
